name: Wende's Remodel
description: A dated condo interior reworked end to end: espresso cabinets and black appliances replaced with navy and white cabinetry, a marble waterfall island and built-in microwave; dark-stained floors replaced throughout with light wide-plank oak.
scope: Kitchen renovation, full flooring replacement, millwork
